result_preview.title: Order Fulfillment Service API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages order lifecycle and customer account service interactions for ticket resolution.
result_preview.description: Exposes order fulfillment status and customer account details to enable service teams to retrieve, manage, and track customer orders throughout their lifecycle. Provides access to order-related service tickets and account information, facilitating coordinated fulfillment operations and customer support workflows.
useCases: Sales fulfillment teams process initial customer orders for the new product while managing inventory and delivery commitments.
Customer account managers verify order accuracy and coordinate logistics for early-stage product shipments.

result_preview.title: Sales Capacity and Time Off Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves employee availability and time-off data for sales capacity planning.
result_preview.description: Exposes employee workforce information and time-off schedules to manage sales team capacity and resource allocation. Provides access to employee profiles and time-off records for workforce planning and sales operations optimization. Manages real-time availability data to support accurate capacity forecasting and campaign staffing decisions.
useCases: Sales leadership schedules workforce availability and manages time-off to maintain customer contact coverage during product transition.
HR coordinators prevent conflicting vacation requests during critical go-live periods.
Sales operations reserve team availability during high-stakes product launch windows.
Regional sales managers confirm team capacity meets customer communication workload for transition period.

args.reason: This API directly manages employee capacity, time-off, and availability scheduling, enabling reserve of employee time allocations for delivery execution as required by the fulfillment process.
